**`CHANGELOG.md`** with:

- **Format header** — references [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html)
- **`[Unreleased]` section** — includes all standard categories (`Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`) with placeholder text ready to be filled in as work progresses
- **`[1.4.0]` entry** — documents the current release based on what exists in the repository (the entry point `main.py`, the manifest/digest tracking, and the banner asset)
- **Version comparison links** — at the bottom for easy navigation between releases
